::: {#hero-heading}

I study what works and doesn't work in policing and crime prevention. My research combines rigorous experimental and quasi-experimental methods with practical experience in policing to evaluate programs, inform policy, and help agencies make decisions based on evidence rather than intuition.

Currently, I am a Ph.D. student in Criminology and Criminal Justice at Arizona State University, where I work with the [Center for Violence Prevention and Community Safety](https://azvdrs.org/staff/). Before entering academia full time, I worked as a crime analyst, private investigator, and detention officer, experiences that continue to shape the questions I ask and the research I conduct.

> *"Good policy begins with good evidence."*

:::
